notes.title: Now Live: Empress POV Content Update!
notes.content:
👑 New Content Update: Empress POV is Here!

You’ve seen the story unfold from one side (perhaps 2 sides ahem)—now it’s time to step into the Empress' perspective!!! You can access her POV from the main menu (make sure to finish the main story first!)

In this brand-new update, you’ll experience the game through the eyes of the Empress herself. Uncover hidden truths, witness secret conversations, and gain a deeper understanding of the power, pressure, and peril behind the palace walls.

What to expect in this update:
✒️ Over 10,000 words of new story exploring the Empress’s past (cue ominous drums...)
👑 A deeper look into our beloved Consort Thanh Tung — including appearances from his childhood
🎭 New character sprites
🎨 A brand new CG

Can't wait to here what you think about this new content update.

-Vi

notes.title: New content update is coming very soon!
notes.content:
📢 [b]Game Update Announcement: Empress Le Pham’s Story Arrives Soon!

[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925573/a3ac023df201619c4fb03b4a360af898bac8cf43.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce that development for our very first free content update is complete — and it’s coming very, very soon!

In this update, players will finally uncover the long-awaited story and point of view of Empress Le Pham, the central mystery we've all been chasing from the beginning.

Originally, we planned to release this as separate DLCs, but we’ve decided to include it as an in-game content update instead. This way, it’s easier and faster for everyone to access directly from the main menu.

What to expect in this update:
✒️ Over 10,000 words of new story exploring the Empress’s past (cue ominous drums...)
👑 A deeper look into our beloved Consort Thanh Tung — including appearances from his childhood
🎭 New character sprites
🎨 A brand new CG 

This is just the beginning — one of several free updates we have planned over the next few years. Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to share more of this world with you!

- Vi and the Imperial Court

notes.title: Finalizing the DLC Plan for "Who Murdered My Empress?"
notes.content:
After months of gathering your feedback, comments, and requests, I’m thrilled to share that we’ve finalized the plan for our free DLCs for Who Murdered My Empress? As of now, we have over 4 DLCs planned, with the potential for even more in the future. 

Each DLC will be released individually, with a 2–4 month gap between launches to ensure we have enough time to polish every update to perfection.

All DLCs will be completely free for anyone who owns the base game. However, to fully understand the story (with the exception of special side scenes involving other characters), you’ll need to have completed the main game. These additions are designed to enrich the narrative and give you even more to explore in the world you’ve grown to love.

This free DLC initiative is our way of thanking you for your incredible support and enthusiasm for the story. Over the next few weeks, I’ll share more details about the first DLC, so stay tuned for updates!

I know some of you may have hoped for these expansions sooner, and I truly appreciate your patience. Balancing a full-time job while also planning another brand-new game has been a challenge, but your encouragement and passion for the story have kept me going. 

Thank you again for being part of this journey—it means the world to me.

More updates coming soon!

- Vi
